purpose: Replace the unused Android development upload key after its old password was included in a native file-picker accessibility preview
proposedActions: Activate the prepared new development upload identity before any first app-bundle upload
Keep the old key/password in retired private custody; do not use them for future signing
Copy the new encrypted PKCS12 to a new dated iCloud recovery folder and safely import its new password into the already approved Bitwarden vault
Verify cloud restore, vault recovery and dummy-JAR signing, keeping independent account access pending until owner verification
